serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed
Lady Annalie: Hey guys!
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy
Lady Annalie: My friends reserved the best spot in the corner. Pretty sweet, right?
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
You: Cool kids spot in the corner.
Bot: Wow, that’s so nice of them!
You: Come on, it’s their cafe. Of course they are gonna reserve the best spot for themselves. Besides, it’s just a hipster cafe.
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: Ohh~ Someone sounds jealous~
You: I’m just stating the fact.
Lady Annalie: I wouldn’t expect you to get rattled so easily~
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Fortunately for you, they are already a pair so you can stop being so on guard.
You: I wasn’t on guard to begin with…
You: Where are they anyway? I don’t see them anywhere.
Lady Annalie: They should be here any minute now.
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
You: Don’t tell me they stood you up.
#bot.Expression.Clear
Lady Annalie: Really? 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: We have known each other for a long time and they know how much this fashion show means to me. Don’t you worry.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal
You: One of those two is your second model, right? Did you at least have a chance to take her measurements? 
#bot.Expression.sad
Lady Annalie: What is this? Are you implying something? If so, say it straight. 
Damn, why is she so touchy about this? I’m just worried.
You: I’m not implying anything. I’m just saying that the time is running out and if they don’t come it could mean trouble.
Lady Annalie: Let me be the one to worry about it, ok? 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: Just so you know. When she couldn’t come for the measurements to be taken she sent me a message with her sizes. She’s no amateur. 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Normal
You: Alright, if you say so. Let’s forget about it.
Lady Annalie: I’m glad you finally got it. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: A-Anyway, how about we order? 
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Sure. 
Bot: So how are the preparations going? Is everything finished?
Lady Annalie: Almost. Small details still need some work and I had to order a few things that were missing. It will be tight, but everything should be ready in time.
Bot: That’s good to hear! Could we come to your shop later and see the finished product? 
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: No~ You can’t~ I want it to be a surprise for everyone, even for you two.
Lady Annalie: I’m so excited, I can’t wait for the show!
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: I should’ve done it sooner, but I was always putting it off and if not for you two I would probably never do it. So thank you for that.
Bot: No, we thank you. We would never realize our goal if it weren't for your help. You put a lot of trust in us. 
Lady Annalie: We haven't known each other for long, but you two never stood me up. It’s not like I’m doing it for free. We are in the same boat here. 
You: Come on. If it was about money you could easily get double or even triple the amount from someone else.
Lady Annalie: That may be so, but I also could get scammed and where is the fun in that. 
Lady Annalie: In any case, if not for you two I would never go back to that island. It sucks to be alone there!
